q8_bottleneck_comment: Scrubbing 45 minutes of audio just to find a 30s clip takes all my Sunday evening.
Syncing and styling subtitles across 10 client videos is the most tedious task in my business.
Title and hook dropoff in first 3 seconds kills my Shorts reach. Need better hook generation.
I do one webinar a month. Turning it into daily LinkedIn content is a full-time job I cannot afford.
I hate timeline editors. If I can edit video by deleting transcript words I would post 3x more.
Clients expect vertical clips, horizontal carousels, and square snippets. Aspect ratio reformatting sucks.
Hardest part is coming up with hooks that don't sound like clickbait but still stop the scroll.
Managing multiple client approvals in Google Drive and Slack threads causes endless delays.
The no credit card free trial is huge. Most SaaS tools lock export behind a paid paywall.
I publish on Spotify and Apple, but never have energy left over for Instagram Reels.
Karaoke animated captions keep viewers watching when muted. Static subtitles get ignored.
Repurposing long videos into shorts takes more editing time than filming the original video.
Carousels drive high save rates on LinkedIn, but formatting slide decks takes forever manually.
Having one screen to schedule to YouTube, Insta and LinkedIn would save me 2 hours every week.
We manage 6 creator channels. Repurposing 1 episode into 10 formats is our exact business model.
Audio mistakes ruin great takes. Being able to patch flubbed voiceovers without re-recording is huge.
The 1-to-10 framework makes total sense. I usually only get 1 clip out of a 20 minute video.
LinkedIn text posts and PDF carousels drive all my inbound consulting leads. Repurposing audio to text is gold.
No credit card required for 300 credits makes it an absolute no-brainer to test on our next show.
If the software handles transcription, text cuts, and caption styling, my agency can double client capacity.
